task_type: supplier media and transactional email closure
requested_outcome: Finish supplier video support and join-form receipt email, publish the exact cumulative candidate, and verify both on production before maker and simulated-Adir approval.
natural_destination: Public VII place galleries and the public join form on vii.spaplus.co.
authorization_boundary: Code, tests, one cumulative production publication, one bounded join receipt test to an owner-controlled address, and production verification are authorized. DNS, audience, supplier writes, billing and unrelated production data remain unchanged.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user requires production proof and two approvals.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Local tests do not count as delivery; exact production video and email flows must be exercised.

lesson_bundle.reason: Video identity and email delivery truth must not be inferred.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Videos remain place-scoped and the UI claims email delivery only after a provider confirmation.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The gallery code supports video but production still drops supplier fields or maps a video to the wrong place.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Verify API normalization, legacy place mapping and the actual production gallery.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Ahuzat Yosef and a second mapped place expose only their verified videos; unsafe or cross-place URLs remain rejected.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The join form says an email was sent when only the lead was accepted.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Send through VII with a stable idempotency key and set emailDelivered only from a provider message ID or an upstream confirmed delivery.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A real production submission receives exactly one receipt and the public success screen truthfully reports it.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A new release overwrites later cumulative fixes or mismatches the edge build.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Publish only a clean descendant of the current cumulative branch, retain rollback identity and rebind the edge to the observed build.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Source guard, build, affected-family tests, exact deployment receipt and public build agreement all pass.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Desktop works while mobile gallery or join form is visually broken.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Inspect the two public journeys at desktop and 390-pixel mobile after deployment.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Video play and join success are usable, modern Hebrew and free of overflow at both viewports.

affected_family: vacation, spa, event and hourly place media normalization
shared place gallery video tab and player
production Site and edge build alignment

midpoint_gate.trigger: After focused implementation tests and before the production build.
checks: Every verified legacy mapping resolves to its exact catalog source URL.
The receipt provider uses a stable submission-scoped idempotency key.
Failure or missing configuration never produces a false sent claim.

attack_questions: Can an unsafe or wrong-place video render?
Can a provider timeout create a false delivery claim or duplicate retry?
Can production serve an older build after deployment?
Can mobile hide the video or join success state?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact public gallery interaction and one owner-controlled join receipt submission on the deployed build.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused tests, full build, source guard, shared-family routes and desktop/mobile production inspection.

effectiveness.baseline: Video support existed locally and partly publicly; join receipt truth depended on the external lead API.
effectiveness.target: Both production journeys pass with no false delivery claim, duplicate receipt or media identity regression.
